purpose: All frozen capacity-probe trajectories, no model/step/seed selection

plan.purpose: Training-only whole-game-disjoint enriched capacity comparison; no formal validation or deployment selection

selectionMethod.wholeGameFold: SHA256(capacity-probe-fold-v1:20261018:{gameId}), first byte even = fit, odd = holdout; all seats/windows of a game remain in one fold. Only actual original train IDs eligible.
selectionMethod.enrichment: Within each fold, eligible games are those whose converted manifest audit.actions.daiminkan > 0. This explicitly uses whole-game target counts to enrich the sampling cohort, never as model features.
selectionMethod.stop: Within each fold scan entire eligible games until each of riichi-positive, riichi-negative, daiminkan-positive, daiminkan-negative has at least the required support. Fail if budget/support exhausted; no expanded scan or fallback.
selectionMethod.windowSelection: Among all eligible opportunity windows in that scanned cohort, keep the lowest SHA256(capacity-probe-sample-v1:20261018:{gameId}:{sampleIndex}:{action}) per stratum using bounded heaps. Negative means actual target action differs from the offered focal action. Retain ALL candidate vectors in their original canonical order and actual target index.
selectionMethod.finalOrder: Within each fold, combine all strata and sort ascending by the same sample hash, gameId, sampleIndex. Assert no window appears in two strata and fit/holdout games never overlap.
selectionMethod.batchOrder: For each initialization seed, NumPy default_rng(seed) generates 2500 draws of 128 distinct fit indices without replacement within a batch, independently across steps. Freeze the full schedules in the sample package; both architectures consume exactly the same schedule for the paired seed.

training.loss: Unweighted full legal candidate cross entropy only; no action weights, auxiliary loss, rewards or engineered features
training.savedResearchWeights: All four final-step arms, plus all five metric records per arm. Not runtime-exported or deployment-eligible.

primaryComparison.pairedBy: initialization seed and exact batch schedule; fixed identical data for every arm
primaryComparison.report: Report both paired larger-minus-current differences, fit/holdout NLL, complete action accuracy, and focal type recall, exact positive recall, FPR, precision and binary balanced accuracy. Preserve every arm, including failures; no best-seed or best-step selection. Intermediate points show learning trajectory only.
interpretation: If both seeds show better fit and holdout loss for the larger model, with concordant focal improvements and disclosed FP/recall tradeoffs, this supports added capacity being useful under this probe budget; it is not proof of the full-corpus cause.
Better fit but unchanged/worse holdout suggests memorization or generalization limitations; it does not justify widening the production model.
If both architectures fit strongly yet holdout remains weak, capacity insufficiency alone is less supported; missing useful features, label variability and cohort mismatch remain alternatives.
Failure to fit or continued improvement at 2500 steps leaves optimizer and finite training budget unresolved. Equal updates do not prove convergence or equal compute.
Mixed seeds, metrics, or actions are inconclusive; do not select the favorable seed, checkpoint or action to claim success.

This probe changes channels and hidden width together. It cannot uniquely separate parameter count, inductive bias, and optimization conditioning, nor localize a benefit to the state encoder versus candidate scorer.

limitations: Artificially balanced action strata and games enriched for recorded daiminkan are not the natural training/validation population. In particular precision and accuracy here are not deployable rate estimates.

Internal holdout uses whole games from the original formal train split. It has not trained these freshly initialized probe arms, but is not a new formal validation/test set and is not a blind final quality claim.
Only two initialization seeds and 128 holdout positive labels per action; seed agreement is limited evidence, not a formal significance claim or guarantee.
Enrichment selects games using complete-game action counts; this is a sampling condition only, never a model input. It may shift context distributions for both positive and negative examples.
No original formal validation or test payloads, raw games, or converted sample payloads are read. Cache source hashes are verified against frozen metadata without rereading those source payloads.
Complete semantic candidate objects are absent from caches; exact vectors and targets are preserved but this preparation does not independently re-prove semantic mask correctness.
The prior 256-window memorization/gate experiment is not rerun. This new probe adds whole-game-disjoint internal holdout and a paired width comparison.
No thresholds or selection rules from the 8-epoch full-training program change. No probe model can be selected for deployment or installed in the App.
